name: hotspot-analysis
description: Agent skill to rank Java files and methods by a Composite Hotspot Score (recency-weighted churn × cognitive complexity × coverage gap) so testing and refactoring effort goes where bugs are most likely to live.

plugins.name: hotspot-analysis
plugins.description: Drives the hotspot-analysis Java CLI to score a local git repository's Java files and methods by a Composite Hotspot Score (recency-weighted revisions × cognitive complexity × coverage gap) and emit CSV/YAML/Markdown/HTML reports. Based on Adam Tornhill's 'Your Code as a Crime Scene'.
